A few good questions

Before you settle in.

Do I need to create an account?

No. Budgetly stores your profile and records locally. You can choose a name and avatar without registering an account.

Does Budgetly connect to my bank?

No. You enter your records yourself. Planned calendar entries can also be recorded automatically within the app when configured. Budgetly does not access bank accounts or move money.

How do I keep a backup?

Open Profile → Backup & Restore to export a backup file. On supported Android devices, you can also select a folder for automatic backups. Backup files are not encrypted by Budgetly, so keep them somewhere secure.

Can I delete my information?

Yes. Edit or delete individual records, or use Profile → Clear All Data to reset the app. Exported backups remain until you delete those files separately.
